author: dfoley323
body:
* Find ward of orn. on arcanists, and transference.
* unlock other jobs as needed for abilities. 5 summons is a bit much.  You will want deific channel and realm shift.
* I would personally unlock smn-h 1st for the dragon, then smn-a for the warrior gear, then finally, celestial axe
* baldr gear from battle fields is very good starting gear if you can snag some ornate, you are gonna wanna get your ward up to 100k+.  I personally sit at 125k, but can get it up to 150+ if i am running spiked shield builds.
* hold off on accensions until you unlock all the job abilities you need.
